packageRules.description: Do not open major-version PRs for typescript (Angular 22 requires typescript >=6.0 <6.1; TS 7 will not compile until Angular raises this range)

Do not auto-update native Android Gradle dependencies at all (AGP, Gradle wrapper itself, AndroidX, Kotlin, Firebase gradle plugins), including majors. These are scaffolded/managed by Capacitor and only get bumped manually to stay compliant (see the reverted Gradle 9 migration)
